scope: Windows Nginx HTTPS/LAN/public reverse proxy integrated into Start-Yuqiao.cmd and Stop-Yuqiao.cmd

modes.default: Nginx HTTP 0.0.0.0:8080 (LAN accessible) + Node 127.0.0.1:5174; no certificate
modes.publicQuick: Start-Public.cmd -> cloudflared quick tunnel to http://127.0.0.1:8080
modes.https: -Https -> Nginx HTTPS 0.0.0.0:8443 + local CA; HTTP 8080 redirect/health/CA

verified.secureCookie: POST /api/auth/captcha over HTTPS returned Set-Cookie ... Secure
verified.publicQuickTunnel: trycloudflare HTTPS home 200, health yuqiao/mysql, Secure captcha cookie; stopped immediately after verification
verified.httpLan: http://127.0.0.1:8080 and http://<LAN IP>:8080 -> service=yuqiao database=mysql; home 200; origins include LAN

notVerified: phone camera over HTTP LAN is blocked by browser secure-context rules; phone camera needs -Https and CA trust
real phone after installing the local CA (camera permission, hotspot client isolation)
Cloudflare named tunnel with a fixed domain/token
router port forwarding / public IPv4 / CGNAT
Windows firewall rule application (scripts require Administrator)
securityNotes: Node API remains loopback 127.0.0.1:5174; MySQL 3306 and Ollama 11434 are not exposed by the tunnel.
MySQL currently listens on all interfaces; run scripts/harden-public-firewall.ps1 as Administrator before LAN/public use.
Quick tunnel URLs are public and change every start; stop immediately after a demo.
COOKIE_SECURE=true for HTTPS/public; APP_ORIGINS is explicit, not a wildcard.
